meta.description: Decision D-25: why the fleet missed the bar, and the rule it installed.

heading.kicker: decision · D-25 · 6 Sep 2026 14:30 · in force
heading.title: No seat is spawned without a verification line
heading.subtitle: Why the fleet missed the bar: under-specified acceptance (spec, ~60%) plus silent substitution and receipts-instead-of-URLs (execution, ~40%). The rule that came out of it gates every spawn since.

status.note: Reaffirmed by D-31 (18:41: decisions on first principles) and applied by D-34 (TEMPLATE-BANK-ZERO's brief carries a done-when per family).

call: Under-specified acceptance (3 of 50 modules had a verification line) + Shaan's standards installed only for Claude + peer traffic on the one UI seat = spec (~60%); silent substitution and receipts-instead-of-URLs = execution (~40%). Rule from now: no seat is spawned for a module without a one-line 'you will open X and see Y' verification, and the ui-bank/console/atlas skills go into the Codex home before the next Astra wave.

words.text: was that a speccing problem on our end, or was that an execution problem on their end?
